column2: (13) The Office may with the consent of such officer or

column1: employee propose secondment of its officers or employees
to other state institutions or regulatory authorities in Sri Lanka
or  abroad  for  a  period  determined  by  the  Office  on  an
assignment  agreed  upon  between  such  institution  or  the
authority and the Office. The period of secondment shall be
deemed to be considered as service to the Office.
